promotion_rule.rule: Promote only a configured exact test binding that ran on its intended path in the bound checkout and tier. Every required test must pass setup, call and teardown, emit a fresh receipt with matching intended_path and nonempty hashed artifacts, and have no skip/xfail. Verify module paths and commit in the pytest process. Hython requires measured build 22.0.400. Missing bindings, missing host, missing evidence, deselection, skip and wrong path never promote. GUI is always NOT_RUN in this command. Suite success alone never promotes a product row.
